verdicts.reason: Both candidates have nearly the same layout and the same flaws. The left arrow ornament is stretched into a blurry smear, and the light-blue side strip stops abruptly halfway down. The illustration runs off the right edge. 'YOUR EFFICIENT' is split far away from 'ENERGY USE' by a large dead gap, and the bottom third is empty, so the headline floats with no grouping. B's headline is slightly larger, but it doesn't fix any of these problems.
